dogecoin.text: The US Debt Clock website has introduced a new section dedicated to Dogecoin (DOGE), referred to as the 'DOGE Clock.' Feature is designed to calculate the savings generated by DOGE, reflecting the growing interest & integration of cryptocurrency in financial monitoring platforms.
